title: Italian Sausages Braised with Green Lentils and Rosemary
summary: A rustic Italian-style dinner of browned pork sausages gently braised with earthy green lentils, tomato, rosemary and vegetables. It is hearty, savoury and ideal for a cool evening with crusty bread or a simple salad.
steps: Heat the olive oil in a wide, heavy pan over medium heat. Add the pork sausages and brown them on all sides for 6–8 minutes, then lift them onto a plate; they do not need to be cooked through yet.
Add the onion, carrot and celery to the same pan with a pinch of the measured salt. Cook for 6–8 minutes, stirring often, until softened and lightly golden.
Stir in the garlic, rosemary and bay leaf and cook for 1 minute until fragrant. Add the tomato paste and cook for another minute, stirring it into the vegetables.
Pour in the red wine and simmer for 2 minutes, scraping up any browned bits from the base of the pan, until slightly reduced.
Add the rinsed green lentils, canned tomatoes, chicken stock, remaining salt and black pepper. Stir well, then nestle the browned sausages back into the lentils.

Bring to a gentle simmer, cover loosely and cook for 30–35 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the lentils are tender and the sausages are cooked through. Add a splash of water if the pan looks dry before the lentils are done.
Remove the bay leaf. Taste and adjust the seasoning if needed, then rest for 5 minutes so the sauce thickens slightly. Scatter with chopped parsley and serve hot.
